name: ProteinShake
description:
We present ProteinShake, a Python software package that simplifies dataset
creation and model evaluation for deep learning on protein structures. Users can
create custom datasets or load an extensive set of pre-processed datasets from
the Protein Data Bank (PDB) and AlphaFoldDB. Each dataset is associated with
prediction tasks and evaluation functions covering a broad array of biological
challenges. A benchmark on these tasks shows that pre-training almost always
improves performance, the optimal data modality (graphs, voxel grids, or point
clouds) is task-dependent, and models struggle to generalize to new structures.
ProteinShake makes protein structure data easily accessible and comparison
among models straightforward, providing challenging benchmark settings with
real-world implications.

ProteinShake is available at: https://proteinshake.ai
evaluation_method: task-specific metrics (RMSE, Pearson correlation, AUC, accuracy depending on task)
general_score_metric: task-specific (Pearson correlation / RMSE / AUC as appropriate)
reputation: A recent toolkit/benchmark gaining traction among structural biology and protein ML practitioners for standardized dataset creation and evaluation.
notes: Multi-task, multi-modality benchmark (graphs, voxels, point clouds). Pretraining effects and modality trade-offs reported. Potential AlphaFoldDB/PDB overlap and generalization challenges across novel structures; non-LLM benchmark.
